day_local: Jimcaha Toddobaadkii Soddonka ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda iyo nimcada Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Sidee bay u weyn yihiin shuqullada Rabbiga!
homily:
Maanta, waxaan rabaa inaan idin weydiiyo inaad maskaxda ku haysataan hal sawir oo aad u fudud, laakiin aad u qoto dheer: waa sawirka gacanta oo la fidiyey si looga soo saaro wax ku jira meel qoto dheer. Bal qiyaas in aad socoto, oo aad si lama filaan ah u aragto wax ku dhacay meel godan, meel ay adag tahay in la gaaro. Ma istaagaysid inaad weydiisato ogolaansho. Ma weydiinaysid haddii ay tahay maalinta saxda ah ee aad qof caawin karto. Waxaad si degdeg ah u fidisaa gacantaada si aad u badbaadiso. Waa sawirka Ciise ee Injiilka maanta, markii uu arkay ninkii qabay cudurka bararka, isagoo aan ka cabsanayn sharciyada adag ee dadka, wuxuuna ku yiri: 'Iska kac oo soco.'

Benjamin Vo wuxuu ahaa wiil noloshaas jacaylka ah inoo ahaa. Waxaan ognahay inuu ahaa wiil maskaxdiisu ay ku dhex noolayd dunida tiknoolajiyadda, koodhka, iyo riyada ah inuu abuuro 'con chim airlines', shirkaddaas yar ee uu mar walba qosol iyo dhoola caddayn ku xasuusin jiray markii uu ka sheekaynayey. Laakiin waxaa jiray shay ka sii weyn maskaxdiisa: wuxuu ahaa wiil had iyo jeer diyaar u ahaa inuu gacantiisa u fidiyo dadka kale. Xusuusnow markii uu dhowr sano ka hor, isagoo da' yar, uu u sheegay waalidkiis inuu rabayo inuu bixiyo lacagtiisa sanduuqa ku jirta si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanaa? Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn in la jebiyo, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu diyaar u yahay inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto si uu qof u caawiyo waa calaamad muujinaysa jacayl aan xad lahayn. Taasi waa gacantii Ben oo mar walba u furan qoyskiisa iyo dadka uu jeclaa.

Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo culus. Waxaan rabaa inaan si daacad ah idiinla hadlo. Waxaa jira saacado marka aad guriga dhexdiisa dareemaysaan in booska Ben uu yahay mid aan marnaba buuxsami karin. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan waqtiyo aad naftiina ku eedaysaan, ama aad is weydiisataan haddii aad wax ka qaban karteen. Fadlan, halkan ku hakada. Maanta, waxaan rabaa inaan idin sheego runta: Ilaah wuu idin arkaa. Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwii weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents.' Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Waxaad dareemi kartaa xorriyadda inaad baroorato adigoon dareemin dambi, waayo jacaylkaaga ayaa ahaa kan ugu weyn.

Injiilka maanta wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in Ciise uu u yimid inuu dadka ka xoreeyo culeyska iyo xanuunka. Wuxuu weydiiyay kuwa sharciga ku dhuumanaya: 'Who among you, if your son or ox falls into a cistern, would not immediately pull him out on the sabbath day?' Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in jacaylku uu ka sarreeyo sharciga. Jacaylka Ilaah waa mid aan la joojin karin. Ben, isaguna, wuxuu ahaa wiil jacaylkaas ku noolaa. Wuxuu ahaa wiil naxariis badan, wiil qosolkiisu uu ahaa mid dadka kale kor u qaada. Wuxuu ahaa wiil jeclaa inuu adduunka arko, oo hadda, wuxuu ka arkaa adduunka meel ka sii sareysa. Wuxuu ku jiraa 'Banquet of Heaven', isagoo ah meel uu ka arki karo adduunka oo dhan, oo dhoola caddaynaya.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, xusuuso in Ben uu weli ku jiro wadnahaaga. Adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ha ka baqina inaad nolosha ku raaxaysataan, waayo Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdaan. Wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Sida gacantii uu Ben u fidiyay qoyskiisa, jacaylka uu kuu hayo wuxuu sii wadi doonaa inuu ku dhex koro nolol maalmeedkaaga, isagoo ku siinaya xoog iyo rajo.

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in geedka noloshaada uu weli Ilaah daryeelayo, isagoo ku daraya jacayl maalin kasta. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad joogto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kuu jecelahay wax walba ka sarreeya, waxaana rabaa inaan naftayda kuugu dhiibo. Maadaama aanan hadda kuu qaadan karin Sakramental-ka, fadlan igu soo gal ruux ahaan qalbigayga. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sidii adigoo horey ii jooga, waxaana isku xirayaa naftayda adiga. Ha ii oggolaan inaan waligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin xafido, oo ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa weligeed ah. Nabadda Masiix ha idinla jirto.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay ee dhintay, inuu Rabbigu ku soo dhaweeyo iftiinkiisa iyo nabaddiisa weligeed ah.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, inuu Ilaah siiyo dulqaad, rajo, iyo dareen ah inuu mar walba la jiro.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Bawlos iyo Timoteyos, oo ah addoommadii Ciise Masiix, waxay u qorayaan dhammaan quduusiinta ku sugan Ciise Masiix ee jooga Filiboy, iyo kormeerayaasha iyo deeqbixiyeyaasha: Nimco iyo nabad ha idinla jirto oo ka timaada Ilaaha Aabbaheenna ah iyo Rabbiga Ciise Masiix. Waxaan Ilaahayga ugu mahadnaqayaa mar kasta oo aan idin soo xusuusto, anigoo mar walba tukashadayda oo dhan idinugu baryaya farxad, sababtoo ah wada-shaqeyntiinna Injiilka tan iyo maalintii ugu horreysay ilaa hadda. Waxaan ku kalsoonahay tan, in kii hawsha wanaagsan idinku bilaabay uu sii dhammaystiri doono ilaa maalinta Ciise Masiix. Waa sax inaan saas u fikiro idin wada, maxaa yeelay waxaan idinku hayaa qalbigayga, idinkoo dhammaantiin ah wada-hawlgalayaashayda nimcada, labadaba xadhigayga iyo difaaca iyo xaqiijinta Injiilka. Waayo Ilaah baa markhaati ii ah, sida aan dhammaantiin idiinku xiisayo jacaylka Ciise Masiix. Ducadayduna waa tan: in jacaylkiinnu uu sii kordho oo uu sii bato aqoonta iyo garashada nooc kasta ah, si aad u kala saartaan waxa qiimaha leh, si aad u ahaataan saafi ah oo aan eed lahayn maalinta Masiix, idinkoo ka buuxa midhaha xaqnimada ee ku yimaada Ciise Masiix, ammaanta iyo mahadnaqa Ilaah.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Sidee bay u weyn yihiin shuqullada Rabbiga! Waxaan Rabbiga ugu mahadnaqi doonaa qalbigayga oo dhan, shirka iyo kulanka kuwa xaqa ah. Waaweyn yihiin shuqullada Rabbiga, oo aad u qurux badan. R. Sidee bay u weyn yihiin shuqullada Rabbiga! Sharaf iyo ammaani waa shuqulkiisa, xaqnimadiisuna weligeed way sii jiri doontaa. Wuxuu caan ka noqday shuqulladiisa cajaa'ibka leh; Rabbigu waa naxariis iyo raxmad. R. Sidee bay u weyn yihiin shuqullada Rabbiga! Wuxuu cunto siiyay kuwa isaga ka cabsada; weligiis wuxuu xasuusan doonaa axdigiisa. Wuxuu dadkiisa u muujiyay awoodda shuqulladiisa, isagoo siinaya dhaxalka quruumaha. R. Sidee bay u weyn yihiin shuqullada Rabbiga!

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Maalin Sabti ah ayaa Ciise u tagay inuu wax la cuno mid ka mid ah Farisiiyiinta ugu waaweyn, dadkiina way u fiirsanayeen si taxadar leh. Hortiisa waxaa joogay nin qaba cudurka bararka. Ciise wuxuu ku yiri culimada sharciga iyo Farisiiyiinta: 'Ma xalaal baa in la bogsiiyo maalinta Sabtida mise maya?' Laakiin way aamuseen; markaasuu ninkii qabtay, ka dib markuu bogsiiyayna wuu iska diray. Markaasuu ku yiri iyagii: 'Kumaa idinka mid ah, haddii wiilkiisa ama dibigiisu uu ku dhaco god, aan isla markiiba soo saari doonin maalinta Sabtida?' Laakiin way awoodi waayeen inay ka jawaabaan su'aashiisa.

day: Friday of the Thirtieth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
